answer: Work waits on the vertex until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the onyx of the next round. Reaching the sable of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on invitation quota tree, converted to a slow vesting stream, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
